title: Quenched Fluffy Korean Napa Cabbage Stew
description: A sweet and comforting pressure-cooked stew that turns napa cabbage into a fluffy, silky broth. Egg-free and packed with flavor, it pairs perfectly with steamed rice.
instructions: Rinse and slice the napa cabbage into bite sized pieces.
Soak the dried shiitake mushrooms in warm water for 15 minutes, then slice.
Heat the sesame oil in the pressure cooker on sauté mode, then add the minced garlic and ginger; cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Stir in the sliced mushrooms, napa cabbage, gochujang, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sugar until the cabbage is slightly wilted, about 2 minutes.
Pour in 3 cups of water, close the lid, and set the pressure cooker to high pressure for 5 minutes.
Release the pressure naturally for 5 minutes, then quick release the remaining pressure.
Open the lid, stir in the cubed silken tofu, and let the stew simmer for an additional 2 minutes on the sauté setting.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt or additional soy sauce if needed.
Ladle the stew into bowls, garnish with sliced green onions, and serve hot with steamed rice.
